## Why This Is Asked

This task mirrors real-world enterprise document privacy requirements at companies like Adobe and Scale AI, demanding multilingual redaction with layout preservation and robust governance.

## Key Concepts
- Layout-preserving OCR and multilingual NER
- Redaction masks that maintain typography and spacing
- Privacy controls: encryption, minimal logging, audit trails
- Model versioning and canary rollouts
- Evaluation: offline F1, latency targets, drift detection, rollback

## Code Example
```python
def redact(doc, entities):
    # Apply layout-aware redaction with preserved formatting
    for entity in entities:
        mask = create_mask(entity, preserve_layout=True)
        doc.apply_mask(mask, maintain_spacing=True)
    return doc
```

## Why This Is Asked

Real-time PII redaction is critical for compliance and privacy in customer chat systems across domains and languages. This question tests ability to combine simple regex with a learnable component and reason about latency and privacy.

## Key Concepts

- PII patterns, regex, obfuscated formats
- Lightweight ML with bilingual data
- Latency and on-device inference
- Data privacy and logging controls

## Code Example

```javascript
// PII redaction detector (regex-based)
function redactPII(text){
  const email = /[a-zA-Z0-9._%+-]+@[a-zA-Z0-9.-]+\.[a-z]{2,}/gi;
  const phone = /(\+?\d{1,3}[-.\s]?)?(\(?\d{3}\)?[-.\s]?)?(\d{3})[-.\s]?(\d{4})/g;
  return text
    .replace(email, '[REDACTED_EMAIL]')
    .replace(phone, '[REDACTED_PHONE]');
}
```
